title: sdks: unify auth/retries and streaming ergonomics across Python/TS/Go + parity bump v1.37.0
author: Asha Raman
description:
Motivation: multiple SDKs (Python, TypeScript, Go) had diverging behavior around auth token refresh, retry surface, and streaming ergonomics which caused customer confusion and intermittent failures when falling back to non-streaming paths. This PR unifies the SDK surface so developers have consistent semantics across languages and bumps SDK versions to v1.37.0 across packages.

What changed (high level):
- Introduced a shared auth middleware contract and unified token refresh/resiliency strategy (exponential backoff + jitter + leash on retries) implemented in each SDK idiomatically.
- Standardized retryable status codes and idempotency hints across Generate/Chat/Embeddings endpoints.
- Streaming: stabilized reconnect semantics and introduced a light-weight client-side resume token for interrupted streams; simplified streaming APIs for Python/TS to use iterator/async iterator ergonomics and added a channel-based Go API.
- Parity fixes: aligned request/response shape fields (model_version, metadata) and normalized error types to match server spec.
- Version bumps: python-sdk 1.37.0, typescript-sdk 1.37.0, go-sdk v1.37.0.

Checklist: 
- [x] auth/retries contract drafted and reviewed by infra
- [x] Python implementation and tests
- [x] TypeScript implementation and tests
- [x] Go implementation and tests
- [x] Integration tests against mock server
- [x] Docs updates and CHANGELOG entries

Backward compatibility notes: The public APIs remain backward compatible for the vast majority of users. A small number of streaming helper methods were renamed for clarity; shims remain in place with deprecation warnings for one release. No server-side changes required.

Related: ENG-3421 (unify SDK retry semantics), ENG-3478 (streaming resume token design), SUP-1287 (customer support escalation reproducer)

Merge strategy: squash and merge into main once CI green and approvals obtained.
